name: Titagarh Rail
why: Profit breakout: +70% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Strong order book: 8.8x annual sales (revenue visibility)
Credit rating AA-/Stable (CRISIL) - strong balance sheet
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Good (sales -1% YoY, profit +70% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) raised holding by 1.8 pts in a year
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 3.2 pts in a year
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 91% to 87% of sales)
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual sales, annual profit
Working capital stretching - debtor days 63 to 72, inventory days 65 to 92 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)

order_book: Overall order book of the company, including its share of the joint ventures, has gone up to about INR28,600 crores to INR28,700 crores.
In terms of the order book, the standalone order book, the passenger rail system is almost 70% of the order book.
guidance: The most important of that being the number of metro cars invoiced during the quarter, which has gone up to 51, which means that we have been able to hit the run rate of 200 cars that was targeted for the year.
As has been mentioned in the presentation, we will be targeting to get back to a 1,000 wagon mark by Q4 of this financial year itself.
capex: Line 5, the other part of the work, systems work, has already started getting commissioned by us, with telecomm and signaling.
risks: Apart from that, the uncertainty or the short-term uncertainty that was prevailing for the wagon demand has been to a large extent addressed by way of this receipt of the option quantity of orders from the Indian Railway
Are there any delays or anything on that regard?
focus: As has been mentioned in the presentation, we will be targeting to get back to a 1,000 wagon mark by Q4 of this financial year itself.
In H1 FY27, we did nearly 81 coaches , and we are targeting 200 coaches, making another 100 coaches to 120 coaches may not be that challenging.
The new production area of the production bay for the aluminum is under construction.
